title.es: El de cuando Marta perdona a Cloe
title.en: The One Where Marta Forgives Cloe

description.es: Cloe se disculpa con Marta por ocultarle la pista sobre Fina y admite lo difícil que le resulta superar su ruptura. Marta, aunque enojada, la comprende y le confiesa que la llamada solo confirmó que Fina ha estado gravemente enferma y que la asociación no sabe más de ella. Cloe intenta animarla, pero Marta, abatida, teme haber llegado demasiado tarde en su búsqueda.
description.en: Cloe apologizes to Marta for hiding the lead about Fina and admits how hard it is for her to get over their breakup. Marta, though angry, understands and confesses that the call only confirmed that Fina has been gravely ill and that the association knows nothing more about her. Cloe tries to cheer her up, but Marta, dejected, fears she may have been too late in her search.
